mapper.select: WITH ra AS ( SELECT DISTINCT warehouse_id, rack_no FROM wms_rack_assignment WHERE wms_tenant_id = #{wmsTenantId} AND effective_from <= #{today} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= #{today}) ), allocated_locations AS ( SELECT l.id AS location_id, l.warehouse_id, l.location_code FROM wms_location l JOIN ra ON ra.warehouse_id = l.warehouse_id AND ra.rack_no = l.rack_no WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(l.public_shared, 0) = 0 ), assigned_occupancy AS ( SELECT a.warehouse_id, a.location_code FROM allocated_locations a JOIN wms_location_inventory li ON li.warehouse_id = a.warehouse_id AND li.location_id = a.location_id AND li.quantity > 0 AND li.deleted = 0 AND li.wms_tenant_id = #{wmsTenantId} JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = li.erp_tenant_id AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.parent_wms_tenant_id = #{wmsTenantId} GROUP BY a.warehouse_id, a.location_code ), owned_inventory AS ( SELECT li.warehouse_id, COUNT(DISTINCT li.location_id) AS occupiedLocations, COALESCE(SUM(li.quantity), 0) AS onHandQty FROM wms_location_inventory li JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = li.erp_tenant_id AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.parent_wms_tenant_id = #{wmsTenantId} WHERE li.wms_tenant_id = #{wmsTenantId} AND li.quantity > 0 AND li.deleted = 0 GROUP BY li.warehouse_id ) SELECT w.id AS warehouseId, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, w.warehouse_code AS warehouseCode, reg.region_name AS regionName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ra WHERE ra.warehouse_id = w.id) AS rackCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM allocated_locations a WHERE a.warehouse_id = w.id) AS allocatedLocations, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assigned_occupancy o WHERE o.warehouse_id = w.id) AS occupiedLocations, COALESCE((SELECT o.onHandQty FROM owned_inventory o WHERE o.warehouse_id = w.id), 0) AS onHandQty FROM wms_warehouse w LEFT JOIN wms_region reg ON reg.id = w.region_id WHERE w.deleted = 0 AND w.id IN ( SELECT warehouse_id FROM ra UNION SELECT warehouse_id FROM owned_inventory ) ORDER BY w.id

SELECT a.rack_no AS rackNo, a.monthly_fee AS monthlyFee, a.effective_to AS effectiveTo, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_location l WHERE l.warehouse_id = a.warehouse_id AND l.rack_no = a.rack_no AND l.deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(l.public_shared, 0) = 0) AS locationCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT li.location_id) FROM wms_location_inventory li JOIN wms_location l2 ON l2.id = li.location_id AND l2.warehouse_id = li.warehouse_id AND l2.deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(l2.public_shared, 0) = 0 JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = li.erp_tenant_id AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.parent_wms_tenant_id = #{wmsTenantId} WHERE li.warehouse_id = a.warehouse_id AND l2.rack_no = a.rack_no AND li.wms_tenant_id = #{wmsTenantId} AND li.quantity > 0 AND li.deleted = 0) AS occupiedCount FROM wms_rack_assignment a WHERE a.wms_tenant_id = #{wmsTenantId} AND a.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND a.effective_from <= #{today} AND (a.effective_to IS NULL OR a.effective_to >= #{today}) ORDER BY a.rack_no

SELECT li.erp_tenant_id AS erpTenantId, t.tenant_name AS ownerName, COUNT(DISTINCT li.location_id) AS occupiedLocations, COALESCE(SUM(li.quantity), 0) AS onHandQty, COUNT(DISTINCT li.sku_code) AS skuCount FROM wms_location_inventory li JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = li.location_id AND l.warehouse_id = li.warehouse_id AND l.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = li.erp_tenant_id AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.parent_wms_tenant_id = #{wmsTenantId} WHERE li.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND li.wms_tenant_id = #{wmsTenantId} AND li.quantity > 0 AND li.deleted = 0 GROUP BY li.erp_tenant_id, t.tenant_name ORDER BY onHandQty DESC
